readerCopy.body: An opportunity to become more visible can also make the next direction easier to recognize. When the Sun trines the North Node, recognition and forward movement reinforce each other, connecting leadership, authorship, public credit, or a chance to put a name on the work with a choice about what comes next. Attention is most useful when it opens another step rather than becoming the reason the work has to continue forever.
